The '''Anto's Star system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Saijo sector/Legends|Saijo sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Sable III|''Anto's Star'']].<ref name="StandandDeliver">{{JournalCite|5|Stand and Deliver}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Anto's Star system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square K-20.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
